The weakness of the course for me personally was the use of zoom. As an english speaking student only, I sometimes found the classes hard to keep up with. Although classes were taught in english and the instructor was very clear and fluent, there was a lot of turkish/islamic terminology in the course (e.g names of political leaders or documents.) In the classroom before COVID-19, the teacher used a whiteboard to write names or to draw timelines. This meant that I was unsure of how to spell/pronounce turkish names/terminology properly and sometimes got important figures or events in history confused. It would have been much easier if the teacher had used a whiteboard or a power point to show on zoom to help illustrate the correct spellings of these terms. I believe that in future, this well help other students (especially international ones) engage better with the course content.
